header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that when the Prophet ﷺ said, “The Mufarrids have gone far ahead!” the Sahabah asked, “Ya Rasulallah! Who are the Mufarrids?” Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Those who have devoted themselves to the Dhikr of Allah; Dhikr will lighten their burden, so they will come on the Day of Qiyamah free of burden.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَي ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً فِي حِجْرِهِ دَرَاهِمُ يُقَسِّمُهَا وَآخَرُ يَذْكُرُ اللهَ كَانَ ذِكْرُ اللهِ أَفْضَلَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الاوسط ورجاله وثقوا مجمع الزوائد:١٠ /٧٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “One person has a great deal of money and is distributing it. Another person is engaged in the Dhikr of Allah. Of these, the one who is doing the Dhikr of Allah is the better.” Hazrat Abu Musa (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ أَكْثَرَ ذِكْرَ اللهِ فَقَدْ بَرِئئَ مِنَ النِّفَاقِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الصغير وهو حديث صحيح الجامع الصغير:٢ /٥٧٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever does the Dhikr of Allah abundantly has become free of hypocrisy.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِنِ الْخُدْرِيِّ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: لَيَذْكُرَنَّ اللهَ قَوْمٌ عَلَي الْفُرُشِ الْمُمَهَّدَةِ يُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّاتِ الْعُلي.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو يعلي واسناده حسن مجمع الزوائد:٨٠/١٠
blocks.tamil_translation: “Many who do the Dhikr of Allah while on soft beds, Allah, by the barakah of their Dhikr, will admit into the high
